extracted.intended_audience: prospective authors submitting books to McSweeney's (book-length or shorter works intended for McSweeney's publications)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and policies for authors who want to submit book-length (and other) writing to McSweeney's, including current submission status and policy requirements for published authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submissions status — currently closed
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions are currently closed. We don’t have an exact date when they’ll reopen, but we’d suggest checking back in a few months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural note to prospective submitters: wait and check back periodically; no open submission window at present.

rubrics_metrics.name: No AI-assisted writing (absolute prohibition)
rubrics_metrics.description: We accept no writing aided in any manner by AI. Before publishing any writing—from a letter to a book-length work—authors published at McSweeney’s will be asked to attest that AI played no part in the creation or writing of that work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to all writing considered for publication; authors will be required to sign/attest to non-use of AI prior to publication. Do not submit work created or substantially assisted by AI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational sustainability commitment (publisher practice)
rubrics_metrics.description: McSweeney’s is committed to the environment. Each year, we purchase carbon offsets commensurate with our estimate of the impact of the printing, shipping, and travel necessary to publish our books and magazines and continually work to minimize our impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a publisher policy rather than a submission requirement; authors interested in supporting or learning more are directed to contact executive director Amanda Uhle.
